title: THIN-WALLED CURVED SHELL FORMED FROM MULTI-CONIC PREFORM, AND METHODS FOR MANUFACTURING THE SAME
docs.abstract: A semi-ellipsoidal, semi-toroidal, or toroidal shell includes an annular sheet metal wall that is longitudinally segmented so as to include a plurality of annular wall segments. Each of the plurality of annular wall segments is joined to an adjacent wall segment by a respective latitudinal wall weld. Also disclosed is a tank including the shell, a vehicle including the shell, a multi-conic preform used to manufacture the shell, a method for assembling the preform, and a method for manufacturing the shell using the preform.

title: ACTIVELY-COOLED HEAT SHIELD SYSTEM AND VEHICLE INCLUDING THE SAME
docs.abstract: To provide means for rockets and other vehicles that travel at or above hypersonic speeds (e.g., space re-entry vehicles, aircraft, missiles, etc.) to protect themselves from the heating that occurs at such high speeds.SOLUTION: An actively-cooled heat shield system includes a heat shield, a tank, a pump, a heat exchanger, and a turbine. The heat shield defines a windward side of a vehicle. The tank stores a coolant. The pump receives the coolant from the tank and outputs a pressurized coolant. The heat exchanger is integrally connected with the heat shield. The heat exchanger receives the pressurized coolant from the pump, transfers heat from the heat shield to the pressurized coolant to generate a heated fluid, and outputs the heated fluid. An inlet receives the heated fluid output from the heat exchanger. The shaft is coupled to the pump and includes turbine blades. The shaft rotates and powers the pump when the heated fluid received from the heat exchanger acts on the turbine blades.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: MULTISTAGE ROCKET, AND ATMOSPHERIC RE-ENTRY VEHICLE
docs.abstract: To provide an augmented aerospike nozzle, an engine including an augmented aerospike nozzle, and a vehicle including an engine.SOLUTION: An augmented aerospike nozzle includes a throat, a center body extending rearward of the throat, an inside expansion surface defined by the center body, an outside expansion surface outward of the inside expansion surface, and an expansion cavity defined between the inside expansion surface and the outside expansion surface. The engine includes a high pressure chamber and the augmented aerospike nozzle. A vehicle for supersonic flight includes an engine having the augmented aerospike nozzle.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: REUSABLE SPACE VEHICLE FOR LONG-DWELL PAYLOAD HOSTING, ORBITAL MANEUVERS, AND DOWNMASS OPERATIONS, AND RELATED METHOD
docs.abstract: A vehicle configured for in-space and atmospheric reentry operations includes a pressure-fed propulsion engine that uses cryogenic fuel and cryogenic oxidizer as propellants. In some embodiments, the vehicle includes a first conduit configured to provide a first propellant to the pressure-fed propulsion engine, a second conduit configured to provide a second propellant to a heat shield heat exchanger disposed relative to a heat shield wall defining an outer surface of the vehicle, and a pump located along the second conduit. In such embodiments, the first conduit is configured to provide the first propellant to the pressure-fed propulsion engine at a first mass flow rate, the second conduit and the pump are configured to provide the second propellant to the heat shield heat exchanger at a second mass flow rate, and the second mass flow rate is substantially less than the first mass flow rate. A related method is also disclosed.

title: HEAT SHIELD WITH RECESSED DUAL-EXPANSION NOZZLE, AND VEHICLE INCLUDING THE SAME
docs.abstract: A dual-expansion nozzle includes a throat, a first expansion section extending downstream of the throat, and a second expansion section extending downstream of the first expansion section. An inflection point is defined where the first expansion section meets the second expansion section. The first expansion section has a first contour designed for optimal performance throughout a first altitude range. The second expansion section has a second contour designed for optimal performance throughout a second altitude range. The first altitude range and the second altitude range are separated by a third altitude range. Also disclosed is an engine including the dual-expansion nozzle, a heat shield into which at least portions of the nozzle are recessed, and a vehicle including the nozzle.

title: ANNULAR AEROSPIKE NOZZLE WITH WIDELY-SPACED THRUST CHAMBERS, ENGINE INCLUDING THE ANNULAR AEROSPIKE NOZZLE, AND VEHICLE INCLUDING THE ENGINE
docs.abstract: An annular aerospike nozzle for a vehicle, such as an upper stage rocket, is disclosed. The annular aerospike nozzle includes a centerbody and a plurality of thrust chambers spaced around the centerbody. Each thrust chamber has a throat and a nozzle portion extending aft of the throat. The nozzle portion has an exit dimension Dexit at an aft end. Each thrust chamber is spaced away from adjacent thrust chambers by a spacing distance Dspace, such that Dspace ≥ M * Dexit, where M ≥ 1.

title: ACTIVELY-COOLED HEAT SHIELD SYSTEM AND VEHICLE INCLUDING THE SAME
docs.abstract: Un sistema de escudo térmico con refrigeración activa incluye un escudo térmico, un depósito, una bomba, un intercambiador de calor y una turbina. El escudo térmico define el lado expuesto al viento del vehículo. El depósito almacena refrigerante. La bomba recibe el refrigerante del depósito y lo expulsa a presión. El intercambiador de calor está integrado al escudo térmico. Recibe el refrigerante a presión de la bomba, transfiere el calor del escudo térmico al refrigerante para generar un fluido caliente y lo expulsa. La turbina incluye una entrada, un eje y una salida. La entrada recibe el fluido caliente proveniente del intercambiador de calor. El eje está acoplado a la bomba e incluye álabes de turbina. El eje gira y acciona la bomba cuando el fluido caliente recibido del intercambiador de calor actúa sobre los álabes de la turbina. La salida expulsa el fluido caliente. title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR RESOURCE MANAGEMENT AND SCHEDULING
docs.abstract: A system for managing resources and scheduling is disclosed. The system includes a client computer, software executable by the client computer for providing a user interface, a server in data communication with the client computer, a database for storing data in a hierarchical data structure, and a data fusion engine executing on the server. The hierarchical data structure includes a parent node and child nodes linked to the parent node. The data fusion engine is configured to log a workflow to at least one of the child nodes based on user input received via the user interface. A related method and software is also disclosed.

The shaft rotates and powers the pump when the heated fluid received from the heat exchanger acts on the turbine blades. The outlet outputs the heated fluid.

title: 主动冷却隔热罩系统以及包括其的载具
docs.abstract: 一种主动冷却隔热罩系统包括隔热罩、罐、泵、换热器，以及涡轮。隔热罩限定载具的迎风侧。罐储存冷却剂。泵接收来自罐的冷却剂并且输出加压冷却剂。换热器与隔热罩一体连接。换热器接收来自泵的加压冷却剂，将热从隔热罩传递至加压冷却剂以生成加热流体并输出该加热流体。涡轮包括入口、轴，以及出口。入口接收从换热器输出的加热流体。轴联接到泵并且包括涡轮叶片。轴在从换热器接收的加热流体作用在涡轮叶片上时旋转并向泵供能。出口输出加热流体。

title: REUSABLE UPPER STAGE ROCKET
docs.abstract: A reusable upper stage rocket or other atmospheric re-entry vehicle includes a nose, a base opposite the nose, and a propulsion engine toward the base. The propulsion engine includes a high pressure chamber and a nozzle configured to exhaust gas generated by the high pressure chamber. The nozzle includes an initial nozzle portion, a secondary nozzle portion downstream of the initial nozzle portion, and a nozzle exit at a downstream end of the secondary nozzle portion. The secondary nozzle portion includes an inner expansion surface, an outer expansion surface outboard of the inner expansion surface, and an expansion cavity defined between the inner expansion surface and the outer expansion surface.

title: Augmented Aerospike Nozzle, Engine Including the Augmented Aerospike Nozzle, and Vehicle Including the Engine
docs.abstract: An augmented aerospike nozzle includes a throat, a centerbody extending aft of the throat, an inner expansion surface defined by the centerbody, an outer expansion surface outboard of the inner expansion surface, and an expansion cavity defined between the inner expansion surface and the outer expansion surface. An engine includes a high pressure chamber and the augmented aerospike nozzle. A vehicle for supersonic flight includes the engine with the augmented aerospike nozzle.

title: Augmented Aerospike Nozzle, Engine Including the Augmented Aerospike Nozzle, and Vehicle Including the Engine
docs.abstract: An aerospike nozzle for an upper stage rocket of a multi-stage rocket system includes a throat, a centerbody extending aft of the throat, and an expansion surface defined by the centerbody, wherein the centerbody is an annular aerospike having a base that at least partially defines an aft end of the upper stage rocket. An engine includes a high pressure chamber and the aerospike nozzle. A vehicle for supersonic flight includes the engine with the aerospike nozzle.

title: Upper stage rocket including aerospike nozzle defining actively-cooled re-entry heat shield
docs.abstract: An aerospike nozzle for an upper stage rocket of a multi-stage rocket system includes a throat, a centerbody extending aft of the throat, and an expansion surface defined by the centerbody, wherein the centerbody is an annular aerospike having a base that at least partially defines an aft end of the upper stage rocket. An engine includes a high pressure chamber and the aerospike nozzle. A vehicle for supersonic flight includes the engine with the aerospike nozzle.

title: 由多圆锥预成型件形成的薄壁曲面壳体及其制造方法
docs.abstract: 半椭球形、半环形或环形壳体包括环形金属板材壁，该壁被纵向分段以包括多个环形壁段。多个环形壁段中的每一个通过各自的纬向壁焊缝连接到相邻壁段。还公开了包括该壳体的罐、包括该壳体的运载工具、用于制造该壳体的多圆锥预成型件、用于组装该预成型件的方法以及使用该预成型件制造该壳体的方法。

title: THIN-WALLED CURVED SHELL FORMED FROM MULTI-CONIC PREFORM, AND METHODS FOR MANUFACTURING THE SAME
docs.abstract: A semi-ellipsoidal, semi-toroidal, or toroidal shell includes an annular sheet metal wall that is longitudinally segmented so as to include a plurality of annular wall segments. Each of the plurality of annular wall segments is joined to an adjacent wall segment by a respective latitudinal wall weld. Also disclosed is a tank including the shell, a vehicle including the shell, a multi-conic preform used to manufacture the shell, a method for assembling the preform, and a method for manufacturing the shell using the preform.

title: 다중-원추형 프리폼로부터 형성된 얇은 벽부의 만곡형 쉘 및 이를 제조하는 방법
docs.abstract: 반-타원체, 반- 토로이드체, 또는 토로이드체 쉘은 복수의 환형 벽부 세그먼트를 포함하도록 길이방향으로 세그먼트화되는 환형 판금 벽부를 포함한다. 상기 복수의 환형 벽부 세그먼트 각각은 각각의 위도(latitudinal) 벽부 용접에 의해 인접한 벽부 세그먼트에 결합된다. 또한, 상기 쉘을 포함하는 탱크, 상기 쉘을 포함하는 비히클, 상기 쉘을 제조하는데 사용되는 다중 원추형 프리폼, 상기 프리폼의 조립 방법 및 상기 프리폼을 이용한 상기 쉘의 제조 방법이 개시된다.

title: 具有宽间距推力室的环状塞式喷管、包括该环状塞式喷管的发动机以及包括该发动机的运载工具
docs.abstract: 公开一种用于诸如上面级火箭的运载工具的环状塞式喷管。所述环状塞式喷管包括中心本体和围绕所述中心本体间隔开的多个推力室。每一推力室具有喉部和在所述喉部后方延伸的喷管部分。所述喷管部分在后端处具有出口尺寸Dexit。每一推力室与相邻的推力室间隔开间隔距离Dspace，使得Dspace≥M*Dexit，其中M≥1。

title: 非轴对称隔热罩、至少部分由隔热罩限定的喷管、包括喷管的发动机和包括发动机的运载工具
docs.abstract: 公开了一种用于保护运载工具的迎风侧免受高焓流影响的隔热罩。隔热罩包括中心本体侧壁和在中心本体侧壁的后部延伸的中心本体基部。中心本体侧壁和中心本体基部限定非轴对称的隔热罩外表面。还公开了一种至少部分地由隔热罩限定的塞式喷管、一种包括高压室和塞式喷管的发动机以及一种包括发动机的运载工具。

title: A NON-AXISYMMETRIC HEAT SHIELD, A NOZZLE DEFINED AT LEAST PARTIALLY BY THE HEAT SHIELD, AN ENGINE INCLUDING THE NOZZLE, AND A VEHICLE INCLUDING THE ENGINE
docs.abstract: A heat shield for protecting a windward side of a vehicle from a high enthalpy flow is disclosed. The heat shield includes a centerbody sidewall and a centerbody base extending aft of the centerbody sidewall. The centerbody sidewall and the centerbody base define a heat shield outer surface that is non-axisym metric. Also disclosed is an aerospike nozzle defined at least partially by the heat shield, an engine including a high pressure chamber and the aerospike nozzle, and a vehicle including the engine.

title: ANNULAR AEROSPIKE NOZZLE WITH WIDELY-SPACED THRUST CHAMBERS, ENGINE INCLUDING THE ANNULAR AEROSPIKE NOZZLE, AND VEHICLE INCLUDING THE ENGINE
docs.abstract: An annular aerospike nozzle for a vehicle, such as an upper stage rocket, is disclosed. The annular aerospike nozzle includes a centerbody and a plurality of thrust chambers spaced around the centerbody. Each thrust chamber has a throat and a nozzle portion extending aft of the throat. The nozzle portion has an exit dimension Dexit at an aft end. Each thrust chamber is spaced away from adjacent thrust chambers by a spacing distance Dspace, such that Dspace = M * Dexit, where M = 1.

title: HEAT SHIELD WITH RECESSED DUAL-EXPANSION NOZZLE, AND VEHICLE INCLUDING THE SAME
SYSTEM FOR MANAGING RESOURCES AND SCHEDULING, AND RELATED METHOD AND SOFTWARE
docs.abstract: A system for managing resources and scheduling is disclosed. The system includes a client computer, software executable by the client computer for providing a user interface, a server in data communication with the client computer, a database for storing data in a hierarchical data structure, and a data fusion engine executing on the server. The hierarchical data structure includes a parent node and child nodes linked to the parent node. The data fusion engine is configured to log a workflow to at least one of the child nodes based on user input received via the user interface. A related method and software is also disclosed.

title: ACTIVELY-COOLED HEAT SHIELD SYSTEM AND VEHICLE INCLUDING THE SAME
docs.abstract: An actively-cooled heat shield system includes a heat shield, a tank, a pump, a heat exchanger, and a turbine. The heat shield defines a windward side of a vehicle. The tank stores a coolant. The pump receives the coolant from the tank and outputs a pressurized coolant. The heat exchanger is integrally connected with the heat shield. The heat exchanger receives the pressurized coolant from the pump, transfers heat from the heat shield to the pressurized coolant to generate a heated fluid, and outputs the heated fluid. The turbine includes an inlet, a shaft, and an outlet. The inlet receives the heated fluid output from the heat exchanger. The shaft is coupled to the pump and includes turbine blades. The shaft rotates and powers the pump when the heated fluid received from the heat exchanger acts on the turbine blades. The outlet outputs the heated fluid.

title: 넓게 이격된 스러스트 챔버를 갖는 환형 에어로스파이크 노즐, 환형 에어로스파이크 노즐을 포함하는 엔진, 및 엔진을 포함하는 비히클
docs.abstract: 비히클, 예컨대 상부 단계 로켓을 위한 환형 에어로스파이크 노즐이 개시된다. 상기 환형 에어로스파이크 노즐은 중심체 및 상기 중심체를 중심으로 이격된 복수의 스러스트 챔버를 포함한다. 상기 스러스트 챔버 각각은 스로트 및 상기 스로트의 후미로 연장되는 노즐 부분을 갖는다. 상기 노즐 부분은 후미 단부에서 출구 직경(D출구)을 갖는다. 상기 스러스트 챔버 각각은 D이격 ≥ M * D출구(여기에서, M ≥ 1)이 되도록, 인접한 스러스트 챔버로부터 거리(D이격)만큼 이격된다.

title: 비-축대칭성 히트 쉴드, 히트 쉴드에 의해 적어도 부분적으로 정의되는 노즐, 노즐을 포함하는 엔진, 및 엔진을 포함하는 비히클
docs.abstract: 높은 엔탈피 흐름으로부터 비히클의 바람을 향하는 측면을 보호하기 위한 히트 쉴드가 개시된다. 히트 쉴드는 중심체 측벽 및 중심체 측벽의 후미로 연장되는 중심체 베이스를 포함한다. 중심체 측벽과 중심체 베이스는 비-축대칭인 히트 쉴드의 외부면을 정의한다. 또한, 히트 쉴드에 의해 적어도 부분적으로 정의되는 에어로스파이크 노즐, 고압 챔버 및 에어로스파이크 노즐을 포함하는 엔진, 및 엔진을 포함하는 비히클이 개시된다.

title: 增强气动尖锥喷嘴、包括增强气动尖锥喷嘴的发动机以及包括发动机的运载工具
docs.abstract: 一种增强气动尖锥喷嘴包括喉部、在喉部后部延伸的中心体、由中心体限定的内膨胀表面、内膨胀表面外侧的外膨胀表面，以及在内膨胀表面和外膨胀表面之间限定的膨胀腔。一种发动机包括高压室和增强气动尖锥喷嘴。一种用于超音速飞行的运载工具包括具有增强气动尖锥喷嘴的发动机。

title: 多円錐プリフォームから形成された薄壁曲面シェルおよびそれを製造する方法
docs.abstract: 半楕円体、半トロイダル形またはトロイダル形シェルが、複数の環状壁区分を含むように経度方向に区分化された環状金属板壁を含む。複数の環状壁区分の各々が、それぞれの緯度方向壁溶接部によって隣接する壁区分に接合されている。シェルを含むタンクと、シェルを含む輸送手段と、シェルを製造するために使用される多円錐プリフォームと、プリフォームを組み立てる方法と、プリフォームを使用してシェルを製造する方法も開示される。

title: 能動冷却型の熱シールドシステム及びそれを含むビークル

docs.abstract: 【解決手段】 増強型エアロスパイクノズルは、スロートと、スロートの後方に伸びるセンターボディと、センターボディによって規定される内側膨張面と、内側膨張面の外側の外側膨張面と、内側膨張面と外側膨張面の間に規定される膨張キャビティと、を含む。エンジンは高圧室と増強型エアロスパイクノズルとを含む。超音速飛行用のビークルは、増強型エアロスパイクノズルを有するエンジンを含む。 【選択図】図５

title: A NON-AXISYMMETRIC HEAT SHIELD, A NOZZLE DEFINED AT LEAST PARTIALLY BY THE HEAT SHIELD, AN ENGINE INCLUDING THE NOZZLE, AND A VEHICLE INCLUDING THE ENGINE
docs.abstract: A heat shield for protecting a windward side of a vehicle from a high enthalpy flow is disclosed. The heat shield includes a centerbody sidewall and a centerbody base extending aft of the centerbody sidewall. The centerbody sidewall and the centerbody base define a heat shield outer surface that is non-axisym metric. Also disclosed is an aerospike nozzle defined at least partially by the heat shield, an engine including a high pressure chamber and the aerospike nozzle, and a vehicle including the engine.

title: Actively-cooled heat shield system and vehicle including the same
docs.abstract: An actively-cooled heat shield system includes a heat shield, a tank, a pump, a heat exchanger, and a turbine. The heat shield defines a windward side of a vehicle. The tank stores a coolant. The pump receives the coolant from the tank and outputs a pressurized coolant. The heat exchanger is integrally connected with the heat shield. The heat exchanger receives the pressurized coolant from the pump, transfers heat from the heat shield to the pressurized coolant to generate a heated fluid, and outputs the heated fluid. The turbine includes an inlet, a shaft, and an outlet. The inlet receives the heated fluid output from the heat exchanger. The shaft is coupled to the pump and includes turbine blades. The shaft rotates and powers the pump when the heated fluid received from the heat exchanger acts on the turbine blades. The outlet outputs the heated fluid.

title: System for managing resources and scheduling, and related method and software
docs.abstract: A system for managing resources and scheduling is disclosed. The system includes a client computer, software executable by the client computer for providing a user interface, a server in data communication with the client computer, a database for storing data in a hierarchical data structure, and a data fusion engine executing on the server. The hierarchical data structure includes a parent node and child nodes linked to the parent node. The data fusion engine is configured to log a workflow to at least one of the child nodes based on user input received via the user interface. A related method and software is also disclosed.

title: THIN-WALLED CURVED SHELL FORMED FROM MULTI-CONIC PREFORM, AND METHODS FOR MANUFACTURING THE SAME
docs.abstract: Une coque semi-ellipsoïdale, semi-toroïdale ou toroïdale comprend une paroi en tôle annulaire qui est segmentée longitudinalement de façon à comprendre une pluralité de segments de paroi annulaire. Chacun de la pluralité de segments de paroi annulaire est relié à un segment de paroi adjacent par une soudure de paroi latitudinale respective. L'invention concerne également un réservoir comprenant la coque, un véhicule comprenant la coque, une préforme multi-conique utilisée pour fabriquer la coque, un procédé d'assemblage de la préforme et un procédé de fabrication de la coque faisant appel à la préforme.

title: ANNULAR AEROSPIKE NOZZLE WITH WIDELY-SPACED THRUST CHAMBERS, ENGINE INCLUDING THE ANNULAR AEROSPIKE NOZZLE, AND VEHICLE INCLUDING THE ENGINE
docs.abstract: An annular aerospike nozzle for a vehicle, such as an upper stage rocket, is disclosed. The annular aerospike nozzle includes a centerbody and a plurality of thrust chambers spaced around the centerbody. Each thrust chamber has a throat and a nozzle portion extending aft of the throat. The nozzle portion has an exit dimension Dexit at an aft end. Each thrust chamber is spaced away from adjacent thrust chambers by a spacing distance Dspace, such that Dspace = M * Dexit, where M = 1.
